query_clauses: MATCH (t:Tdoc) WITH count(t) AS total MATCH (cr:CR) RETURN total, count(cr) AS crs
semantic_evidence.finding: This is a graph-relative metadata-statistics CQ with affirmative original operational authority, not an external approval or universal physical-document classification. The query is byte-identical to the original; actual diagnostic source mismatches stay preserved but are not alternative golds.

SQL.query: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM node_label WHERE label='Tdoc') AS total, (SELECT count(*) FROM node_label WHERE label='CR') AS crs

CR.query: SELECT count(*) AS instances,count(DISTINCT node_id) AS nodes,count(tdocNumber) AS nonnull_ids,count(DISTINCT tdocNumber) AS exact_ids FROM CR

Tdoc.query: SELECT count(*) AS instances,count(DISTINCT node_id) AS nodes,count(tdocNumber) AS nonnull_ids,count(DISTINCT tdocNumber) AS exact_ids FROM Tdoc
